title: 構網型逆變器
summary: 以電壓成形、下垂與限流穩定性串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect voltage formation, droop and current-limit stability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 角色與模型
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「角色與模型」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop roles and models through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 成形與跟隨：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Forming versus following: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「成形與跟隨」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for forming versus following.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「成形與跟隨」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。構網控制維持內部電壓相位狀態。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for forming versus following, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Grid-forming control maintains an internal voltage-phase state. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。
steps.observationEn: Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「成形與跟隨」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping forming versus following verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「成形與跟隨」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for forming versus following; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 構網控制維持內部電壓相位狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Grid-forming control maintains an internal voltage-phase state.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假想下垂係數 m=0.05 Hz/kW，新增有功 10 kW 導致一次控制頻率變化 Δf=−mΔP=−0.5 Hz。此斜率只供小型模型，未定義實際並網規範，二次控制可另行恢復頻率。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical droop m=0.05 Hz/kW and +10 kW load, primary Δf=−mΔP=−0.5 Hz. This small-model slope is not a grid requirement; secondary control can restore frequency.

quiz.question: 審查「成形與跟隨」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for forming versus following?
options: 構網控制維持內部電壓相位狀態。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「成形與跟隨」的驗證。
只調整「成形與跟隨」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Grid-forming control maintains an internal voltage-phase state.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping forming versus following verification.
Tuning the displayed forming versus following result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 構網控制維持內部電壓相位狀態。 畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。
quiz.explanationEn: Grid-forming control maintains an internal voltage-phase state. Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles.

steps.title: 成形與跟隨：量測與判讀
steps.titleEn: Forming versus following: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對「成形與跟隨」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for forming versus following.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。 比較差異是否符合「構網控制維持內部電壓相位狀態。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles. Compare the result against: Grid-forming control maintains an internal voltage-phase state. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫兩類控制的訊號依存圖。
steps.observationEn: Draw signal-dependency diagrams for both roles.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「成形與跟隨」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping forming versus following verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「成形與跟隨」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for forming versus following; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
